# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Platform and performance refinements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.0 improves platform compatibility, rendering performance, and native WebGPU support. This release updates Apple platform baselines, improves Android texture presentation, and reduces allocations in image and text-processing paths.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Android texture presentation synchronized** — Texture rendering now synchronizes with the display refresh cycle to provide smoother Android output. ([#5345](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5345))
- **Front-buffered streams no longer retain data** — Fixes stream lifetime handling so front-buffered stream data can be released when it is no longer needed. ([#5327](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5327))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Image pixel copies are more efficient** — Managed image pixel-copy operations avoid unnecessary work, reducing overhead when applications transfer image data. ([#5052](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5052))
- **Text feature processing avoids native allocations** — Feature strings no longer require an avoidable native allocation while preserving their existing decoding behavior. ([#5230](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5230))
- **HarfBuzz text encoding reuses buffers** — HarfBuzzSharp pools UTF-32 encoding buffers to reduce allocations during text shaping. ([#5060](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5060))

## Platform

- **Apple deployment baselines raised** — Apple-targeted applications must target the updated minimum deployment versions supported by this release. ([#5383](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5383))
- **WebGPU implementation ships in the native library** — The WebGPU implementation is now included in libSkiaSharp.a, making its native support available to consumers. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5316](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5316))
- **Linux HarfBuzz linkage is isolated** — Bundled HarfBuzz functions are bound locally on Linux to make native loading more reliable alongside other libraries. — ❤️ [@VirgilMing](https://github.com/VirgilMing) ([#5352](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5352), [#5366](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5366))
